notes: relax_uc=true removes the unit-commitment binaries, but exact_connect=true keeps one binary per site grid connection, so the problem stays a MILP; with mipgap 5e-4 it does not close within 300 s. The sanctioned fix is exact_connect=false (Tier B) — accepting fractional 'Connected' values, which is what relax_uc already implies. Loosening mipgap (Tier A) is the alternative.
